title: Expose a non-UI preview regeneration entry point so agents can rebuild the preview rig
description:
## Summary
The creature preview can only be regenerated from the `CreatureEditorWindow` UI. Because the preview root persists in the saved scene while its `CreatureRig` bindings are runtime-only, a domain reload leaves the scene with an unbuilt rig, which disables `RigSkinningSweepDiagnostic` and any other tool that needs `RestSkeleton` or `IndexedBones`. Expose a non-UI entry point so agents and scripts can rebuild the preview.

## Scope
- Add a menu item (for example `Tools/Creature Creator/Regenerate Preview`) that triggers the existing `CreatureEditorWindow.RegeneratePreview` path, or another sanctioned non-UI trigger.
- Do not add a second generation path, and do not change generation, weighting, or rig construction.
- Keep one regeneration implementation; the toolbar button and the new entry point must share it.

## Acceptance Criteria
- The entry point is reachable through `EditorApplication.ExecuteMenuItem` and returns true when the definition is valid.
- After invoking it, `CreatureRig.Bones.Count` equals the generated bone count and `RestSkeleton` is non-null.
- `Tools/Creature Creator/Animation/Skinning Sweep Selected Rig` validates and runs afterwards.
- Invalid definitions still report the existing dialog or a logged reason instead of generating.

## Validation
- EditMode test that invokes the entry point against a valid definition and asserts a built rig, plus a case asserting no generation for an invalid definition.
- Manual MCP check: `ExecuteMenuItem` returns true, `rig.Bones.Count > 0`, and the sweep writes its summary and CSV files under `Assets/Diagnostics/Skinning/`.

## Findings
- Evidence from TSK-0244: `rig.Bones.Count == 0` and `rig.RestSkeleton == null` on the live preview after a domain reload, while the preview root and its bound `SkinnedMeshRenderer` (34 bones) persisted in `Assets/Test.unity`.
- `RigSkinningSweepDiagnostic.TryFindSelectedRig` requires `RestSkeleton != null && IndexedBones.Count > 0`, so `EditorApplication.ExecuteMenuItem` returned `false`.
- Regeneration triggers today are the `Regenerate Preview` toolbar button (`CreatureEditorWindow.cs:460`) and auto-regeneration after definition edits (`ScheduleAutoRegeneration` to `ProcessAutoRegeneration`, lines 3210-3249). Neither is reachable without UI interaction.
- This is a derived follow-up. The user's conditional instruction in TSK-0244 ("you need to have a way to do so if you can't already") did not apply to humans, because regeneration already exists.

## Blockers
None. The `CreatureEditorWindow` methods involved are private, so the entry point needs an intentional internal seam rather than reflection.

## Next Step
Decide whether the seam is a `MenuItem` on `CreatureEditorWindow` or an internal regenerate method plus a thin menu wrapper, then implement with a focused EditMode test.
